rule: Only CC0 files may enter the repo. No archive file is in the repo: none could be downloaded, and none had its CC0 status read. Every piece on the stage is an original procedural stand-in; the archive record it stands for is kept with its rights state.

checks.si-3d-api: WebFetch https://3d-api.si.edu/api/v1.0/content/file/search?q=vessel|plate|candlestick&file_type=glb (2026-11-06): lists 3d_package ids and .glb URLs; fields are title, usage (Web3D/App3D/Download3D), quality, uri, file_type, model_url, file_size. No rights, licence or CC0 field. The q parameter did not filter (same 7 objects for every query, rowCount 1050).
checks.si-open-access: WebFetch https://api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/search with api_key=DEMO_KEY, q=cake, q=fangyi, q="3d_package", q=online_media_type:"3D Images" (2026-11-06): rowCount 0 for every query, so no metadata_usage.access (CC0) value could be read for any record.
checks.si-3d-page: WebFetch https://3d.si.edu/explore?edan_q=bowl and the art_design category search (2026-11-06): not fetched, permission request unanswered.
checks.proxy: curl from the build sandbox (2026-11-06): CONNECT refused (403) by the egress proxy for 3d-api.si.edu, cdn.3d-api.si.edu, api.si.edu, 3d.si.edu, ids.si.edu, smithsonian-open-access S3, api.getty.edu, media.getty.edu, data.getty.edu. No .glb and no image could be downloaded.
checks.github-mirror: git clone (blobs filtered) of github.com/Smithsonian/dpo-voyager and github.com/Smithsonian/OpenAccess (2026-11-06): no .glb models in Voyager; OpenAccess holds only a README (metadata moved to S3, which is refused).
